Miasma Tempest.name: Miasma Tempest
Miasma Tempest.description: The user's signature move: they empty every reserve at once, and a towering storm of churning gas rolls out across a whole city block. Everyone inside without a sealed mask, allies included, takes massive toxic damage and collapses coughing, unable to stand, attack or use a Quirk until the end of their next turn; afterward the user cannot release gas until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
